scope: Four empty-room entrants physically search and mark the rear room, then all exit forward. The only paired command difference is the last entrant's persistent FACE toward the rear portal. An actual shotgun shot at a separate enclosed training target wakes a reserve behind its closed side door. Both plans run exactly 450 fixed STEP after the first shot; no HP, hit, alert, shot or movement injection.
